name: Create Multi-Page Lesson Opener Flipchart
description:
A 7th grade social studies teacher needs a lesson opener flipchart for a unit on the American Revolution. Create a 3-page flipchart with the following structure:

Page 1 — Do Now warm-up: Title 'Do Now' and prompt text asking students what they already know about the American Revolution (include the phrase 'American Revolution' on this page).

Page 2 — Learning objectives: Title 'Learning Objectives' (or 'Objectives') listing at least two goals students will accomplish by the end of the lesson.

Page 3 — Vocabulary preview: Title 'Vocabulary' (or 'Key Vocabulary') with colored rectangle boxes on the canvas — one box for each of the following four terms: Revolution, Colony, Independence, Patriot.

Login as ga / password123. Save the completed flipchart as /home/ga/Documents/Flipcharts/american_revolution_opener.flipchart
